## Resources

Follows handbook 5.5 to 5.8, one model family per week. Checkpoint detail: naive Bayes, SVM and random forest on iris species, plus a linear regression of petal width on the other measurements, all in one comparison table. ISL ch. 3 also covers coefficient inference (standard errors, tests), which the handbook's regression section does not.

| Step | Python | R | MATLAB |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wk 1: Naive Bayes | [Handbook 5.5: Naive Bayes](https://jakevdp.github.io/PythonDataScienceHandbook/05.05-naive-bayes.html); ISLP ch. 4 | ISLR2 ch. 4: Classification; the [discrim package](https://cran.r-project.org/package=discrim) for tidymodels | Function page [fitcnb](https://www.mathworks.com/help/stats/fitcnb.html) |
| Wk 2: Linear regression | [Handbook 5.6: Linear regression](https://jakevdp.github.io/PythonDataScienceHandbook/05.06-linear-regression.html); ISLP ch. 3 | ISLR2 ch. 3: Linear regression; [TMwR ch. 3: A review of R modeling fundamentals](https://www.tmwr.org/base-r) | Function page [fitlm](https://www.mathworks.com/help/stats/fitlm.html) |
| Wk 3: Support vector machines | [Handbook 5.7: Support vector machines](https://jakevdp.github.io/PythonDataScienceHandbook/05.07-support-vector-machines.html); ISLP ch. 9 | ISLR2 ch. 9: Support vector machines | Function page [fitcsvm](https://www.mathworks.com/help/stats/fitcsvm.html) |
| Wk 4: Decision trees and random forests | [Handbook 5.8: Decision trees and random forests](https://jakevdp.github.io/PythonDataScienceHandbook/05.08-random-forests.html); ISLP ch. 8 | ISLR2 ch. 8: Tree-based methods | Function pages [fitctree](https://www.mathworks.com/help/stats/fitctree.html) and [TreeBagger](https://www.mathworks.com/help/stats/treebagger.html) (bagged trees with random predictor selection, i.e. a random forest) |

In MATLAB, the [Classification Learner app](https://www.mathworks.com/help/stats/classificationlearner-app.html) trains naive Bayes, SVM and tree ensembles in one session, which makes it a quick way to check the coded results.
